title: Wladimir Sirakusoff

TELEPHONE: 23036

December 19, 1944.

Mr. Henry Yang,
Foreign Affairs Dept.,
First District Police,
SHANGHAI.

Dear Mr. Yang,

An employee of the German Radio Station, a White Russian by the name of Vladimir Sirakusoff, living at Rue Bourgeat 702, was arrested last week and was last being confined at the Foochow Road Police Station.

I do not know the exact reasons why he was arrested. I have however been assured by his mother and by his wife that he has never engaged in any political activities. Moreover, his wife after speaking with some allegedly competent man from the Gendarmerie informed me that if we were willing to guarantee for him, as far as any political activities are concerned, he would be released. I can safely say that nothing has come to my knowledge regarding any hostile political activity on his part.

His mother and his wife have requested me to do something to help him. May I ask you to be so kind and to let me know as soon as possible if there is any possibility of having him released soon.

Thanking you for your many past favours, with kindest regards,

Very sincerely yours,

Carl Flick-Steger

电话：23036

1944年12月19日。

杨亨利先生，
外事科，
第一区警察局，
上海。

尊敬的杨先生：

德国广播电台的一名雇员，一名名叫弗拉基米尔·西拉库索夫（Vladimir Sirakusoff）的白俄，居住在布尔热瓦路702号（Rue Bourgeat 702），于上周被捕，最后被拘禁在福州路警察局。

我不清楚他被捕的确切原因。然而，他的母亲和妻子向我保证，他从未参与任何政治活动。此外，他的妻子在与一名据称来自宪兵队的有能力的人士交谈后告诉我，如果我们愿意就政治活动方面为他作保，他将会获释。我可以肯定地说，据我所知，他没有任何敌对的政治活动。

他的母亲和妻子请求我设法帮助他。能否请您告知，是否有可能尽快将他释放？

感谢您过往的诸多关照，谨致最诚挚的问候，

您真诚的，

卡尔·弗利克-施泰格

Shanghai, December. 18, 1944.

Mr. C. Flick-Steger,
German Radio Station,
3 Great Western Road

Dear Sir:

I beg to inform you that my son, who is working
on the German Radio Station under your orders, has been
arrested by the police. I want to emphasize, that my son
is in no way connected with any political activity and that
he always strictly adhered to his convictions as a White
Russian emigrant.

I beg you kindly to exercise your influence on
his behalf and lend your assistance in obtaining his release

Yours faithfully,

(signed) U. Sirakusoff
page_data.zh:
（副本！）

上海，1944年12月18日。

C. 弗利克-施泰格先生，
德国广播电台，
大西路3号

尊敬的先生：

谨通知您，我的儿子在您麾下于德国广播电台工作，已被警方逮捕。我要强调，我的儿子与任何政治活动均无关联，且始终严格遵守其作为白俄流亡者的信念。

恳请您代为施加影响，并提供协助，以争取将其释放。

此致
敬礼，

（签名）U. 西拉库索夫
